breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The ground truth resolves the conflict by keeping the half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid and removing the gamma-centered requirement. The generated specification does the opposite — it specifies a 'Gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack grid' with no mention of a half shift. While the logical contradiction is no longer present, the agent's resolution does not align with the ground truth's intended fix.
